content.short: KnowYourCat is a cross-chain attestation data aggregator building portable on-chain and off-chain reputation profiles for dApps on Mantle.
content.description: KnowYourCat is an identity and reputation infrastructure protocol that aggregates attestation data from multiple on-chain and off-chain sources to build comprehensive user reputation profiles portable across different blockchains. These profiles are made available to dApps through the protocol's cross-chain infrastructure, enabling applications to use rich reputation data for gating, personalization, and improved user experiences. Deployed on Mantle, KnowYourCat provides foundational identity infrastructure for the network's ecosystem.
